Analyze.","marks":4,"answer":"I think there are many obstacles to the successful completion of the mentioned development program, such as discrimination, poverty, infrastructural weaknesses, etc. Apart from the disparity in wealth, there are many other obstacles to achieving sustainable development in this country. Lack of transparency and accountability from the individual to the collective level has become a challenge towards achieving the SDGs. Besides, the disparity in earning, consumption, gender, and region; problems originating out of unplanned industrialization and urbanization; lack of measures in addressing natural or social disasters; weaknesses in infrastructural development; shortage of gas, fuel, and power supply; mismanagement in the appropriate marketing of agro-products, etc. are obstructing the way of achieving the Sustainable Development Goals.
